definitions.name: Shattered Soul
definitions.description: A soul scarred by trauma and neglect — its light dim, its will frayed.

definitions.name: Fragile Soul
definitions.description: A brittle soul that startles easily — whole, yet quick to waver.

definitions.name: Stable Soul
definitions.description: A balanced soul — the steady foundation every cultivator builds upon.

definitions.name: Firm Soul
definitions.description: A resolute soul whose conviction steadies the mind and sharpens intent.

definitions.name: Radiant Soul
definitions.description: A luminous soul that burns bright — its willpower blazing like a newborn sun.

definitions.name: Grand Soul
definitions.description: A majestic soul whose presence commands awe — depth and strength in harmony.

definitions.name: Chaos Soul
definitions.description: A primordial, all-consuming soul that bends the very laws of spirit.
